meta.name: porters-five-forces
meta.description: Read an industry's structure through Porter's Five Forces with documented signals per rating, ending at the profit pool. Use when weighing market entry or when margins erode and nobody can say why.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析行业结构,评估市场进入或利润池变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在进入新市场或利润下滑时系统分析行业竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Analyze industry structure to evaluate market entry or profit pool shifts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze industry competition when entering a market or facing margin erosion

howto.what: Claude 会按波特五力剖析指定行业：把竞争、新进入者、替代品、买方、供应商五种力量各评为弱/中/强，附可查证的信号和链接，最后点明利润池在哪、谁在挤压它。
howto.when: 当用户表示要评估是否进入某个市场或行业，或说利润率一直下滑、说不清原因时触发。它会先问行业、决策、地域等最多3个问题，再开始分析。

say.text: 用波特五力帮我看一下临床数据管理行业，我们该进入还是合作？
say.note: 它会先确认范围，再给出带证据的分析。

say.text: 我们的利润率一直被压，给我一个基于证据的五力分析。
say.note: 它会搜索行业信号，点明结构性原因。

say.text: 对北美中型现场服务管理软件做五力分析，决策是进入还是合作。
say.note: 对应原文示例，按此参数执行。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes an industry via Porter's Five Forces, rating each force weak/moderate/strong with cited signals, then pinpoints the profit pool and what squeezes it.
howto.when_en: When weighing market entry, or when margins erode and no one can say why. It first asks up to 3 questions (segment, decision, boundary), then analyzes.

say_en.text: Porter's Five Forces on clinical data management: enter or partner?
say_en.note: It clarifies scope, then gives evidence-backed analysis.

say_en.text: Margins keep shrinking; give me an evidence-based five-forces read.
say_en.note: It searches signals and explains the structural squeeze.

say_en.text: Five forces, mid-market field-service software, North America: enter/partner?
